row.body: The town meeting agenda lists a field update after the public session; the room key is logged returned before residents signed out.
row.title: Town hall agenda

sidecar.gloss: A room is handed back before the public meeting finishes.
sidecar.rival_reading: An ordinary civic meeting could end early and hand off the room to staff; the key log does not identify the field update.

row.body: field dust covers one side of the candle and animal-feed sack; torn warning tape covers the other. the bundle was opened from both ends.
row.title: two traces on the candle

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
